2025.table: Table 2b: Summary of meteorological observations in Hong Kong, 2025
2025.note: The annual summary gives July 17.44 and annual 14.89 MJ/m²/day. It supersedes different values in the earlier December monthly bulletin. Annual integration here uses month length and rounded monthly observations.

scope: Independent radiation-input check, not measured PV yield or calibration. NASA POWER is a grid point at 22.45 N, 114.16 E; HKO is a different station at King's Park. Annual differences include location, source, rounding and UTC/local-calendar boundaries. Historical normals and one recent year have different periods. No automatic correction, inferred bias, P90 or field-accuracy claim. Same-year HKO observations for 2023 and 2024 have not yet been incorporated.
